articles.mainIdea: Heard on the Street Wednesday Recap: AI Selloff Resumes
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Heard on the Street Wednesday Recap: AI Selloff Resumes. U.S. stock indexes fell, with the Nasdaq Composite dopping 1% for the first time in a month. The S&P 500 declined 0.5% while the Dow industrials slipped 42 points. The artificial-intelligence semiconductor leader must meet new security requirements to send H200 chips to China, the Trump administration said. Related tickers mentioned: AMZN, META, MSFT, NVDA, ^DJI, ^GSPC, ^IXIC.
